lines.quote: Designed the beamforming processing architecture for Hallaharju Space Systems' current-generation wideband digital receiver: 32-channel frequency-domain beamforming with sub-sample time-delay compensation, implemented across four SHARC DSPs with inter-processor communication via SRIO.

designed and maintain the real-time pulse-compression and matched-filter processing chain running on Analog Devices SHARC DSPs, written in C++ with deterministic scheduling. The code has been in production across three hardware generations of the ARCS-200 processing unit since 2009.

built the company's internal test-data management and regression-analysis platform (approximately 15,000 lines). Deployed as an installable internal package with automated CI testing, used by all signal-processing and test engineers (currently 12 users).

responsible for RF front-end verification on all ARCS-series processing units -- routine S-parameter sweeps, noise-figure measurements, and receiver-sensitivity characterisation using Rohde & Schwarz ZVB and FSW equipment.
MSc Physics, Kymijoki University of Technology, 2004

lines.quote: Technical lead of the signal-processing group since 2018: six direct reports, responsible for technical direction, sprint planning, and delivery commitments on the ARCS-300 programme.
